title: What Is a Double BBL? Second Brazilian Butt Lift Explained
meta_description: A double BBL is a second fat transfer, not twice the volume at once. When it helps, how long to wait, and why recovery is no shorter.
excerpt: A double BBL usually means a second BBL after the first has healed, not twice the fat in one surgery. Why people get one, why no source gives a waiting period, whether you have enough fat left, and why recovery is no shorter than the first time.
quick_answer:
What is a double BBL?

It usually means a second BBL, done after the first has healed, to add volume or even out shape. ASPS mentions another BBL as a way to smooth contour irregularities. It needs enough donor fat, and recovery is the same as a first BBL. Your surgeon decides after an exam.

notes: Full rewrite to the plan's outline. Title kept: it is the live meta title, shipped 24 Oct, and the post now uses it as its title too. Removes the 6 to 12 month waiting period, local anesthesia, 'streamlined' and faster recovery, 'superior results', 'ensures safer outcomes', 'board-certified surgeons' and 'countless patients'. The post had no images, so hero and card are new. Open with the practice: how it handles second BBLs and revisions, timing and cost; the post says exam first and gives no policy. Quotes came through WebFetch's extraction model, in fragments capped near 125 characters, except the 2018 advisory, which was read in full from the PDF WebFetch saved.
